model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability terms for various language models fine-tuned on different medical specialities. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms”, displays the categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis, titled “Negative probability log terms”, ranges from -27 to -22 and uses a linear scale with tick intervals of 1. The bars represent the negative log probability terms for each model, with the Mistralv0.2-Base model represented in light blue and the fine-tuned models represented in shades of tan. The Cardio model has a bar with a value of approximately -24.8, the Gastro model has a bar with a value of approximately -25.1, the Infect model has a bar with a value of approximately -25.2, the Neuro model has a bar with a value of approximately -25.3, the Obstetrics model has a bar with a value of approximately -25.4, and the Pediatrics model has a bar with a value of approximately -25.5. All bars are sorted in ascending order by value, and no bars are visually emphasized.
